name: Yedora, Grave Gardener
description: A gardener who whispered rites over the fallen so machines could not repurpose them.

description_citations.text: Multiverse Legends: card flavor text (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yedora whispers rites over the fallen, returning their essences to the land before machines can repurpose them.
timeline.quote: She whispered ancient rites over the fallen, bidding their essences return to the land before they could be repurposed by the machines.

citation.text: Yedora, Grave Gardener (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
